== Hero Usage ==
* [[Hero AI]] will only cast this weapon on characters wielding [[martial weapons]].

== Related skills ==
*{{skill icon|Grenth's Aura}}

== Notes ==
* The amount of life stolen is not affected by the amount of damage you would have dealt.
** As a result, consider using this skill on allies that deal the ''least'' amount of attack damage if you want to minimize Nightmare Weapon's damage reduction. 
* Every hit is counted, but [[miss]]es are not. For example, if a [[Barrage]] attack successfully strikes two foes, but misses four others, Nightmare Weapon would only lose two charges.
* Consider using with [[Dual Shot]] (commonly used in conjunction with [[Distracting Shot]]) and particularly [[Triple Shot]] for a [[spike]].

== Trivia ==
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[{{PAGENAME}}/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
